mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals a policy misstep that erodes real returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (defined by UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to profit-taking and anticipation of monetary tightening, as the labor market tightens and inflation pressures build.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current industrial production (INDPRO) level indicates strong economic output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market recovery (HOUST > 1200) signals strong consumer confidence and increased construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.
